name: Front view crosshair disabler for crosshair tweaks
statusMeaning: Calls something that is on Kiln's roadmap. Parts of it may already run.
author: Evga314
description: This is very simple mod, which removes crosshair from front view, which is visible by default in mod crosshair tweaks (when crosshair enabled for third person view). In crosshair tweaks 1.5.3 you can not remove it in settings, so, i made this simple mod
needs: Mixin: 1 point inside the game's methods
